wsl -e bash -lc "cp '<WORKSPACE>/BanhmiTTS/banhmi_train/vits/utils/flows.py' <WSL_PROJECT_HOME>/BanhmiTTS/banhmi_train/vits/utils/flows.py && <WSL_PROJECT_HOME>/env/bin/python -c \"
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, '<WSL_PROJECT_HOME>/BanhmiTTS')
import torch
from banhmi_train.vits.utils.flows import Log, ElementwiseAffine

torch.manual_seed(0)

# --- Test 1: normal small values (should behave ~identically to unclamped) ---
log_flow = Log()
x = torch.rand(2, 2, 10) * 3 + 0.1
mask = torch.ones(2, 1, 10)
y, logdet = log_flow(x, mask, reverse=False)
x_back = log_flow(y, mask, reverse=True)
print('Log forward/inverse roundtrip max diff (normal values):', (x_back - x).abs().max().item())
assert not torch.isnan(y).any() and not torch.isnan(x_back).any()

# --- Test 2: extreme values that would overflow WITHOUT the clamp ---
x_extreme = torch.full((2, 2, 10), 1000.0)  # exp(1000) would be inf unclamped
out_extreme = log_flow(x_extreme, mask, reverse=True)
print('Log reverse with x=1000 (would overflow unclamped): has_nan=', torch.isnan(out_extreme).any().item(), 'has_inf=', torch.isinf(out_extreme).any().item(), 'max=', out_extreme.max().item())
assert not torch.isnan(out_extreme).any() and not torch.isinf(out_extreme).any()

# --- Test 3: ElementwiseAffine with normal logs (should be ~unchanged) ---
ea = ElementwiseAffine(2)
with torch.no_grad():
    ea.logs.fill_(0.5)  # normal small value
xx = torch.randn(2, 2, 10)
y2, logdet2 = ea(xx, mask, reverse=False)
x2_back = ea(y2, mask, reverse=True)
print('ElementwiseAffine roundtrip max diff (normal logs=0.5):', (x2_back - xx).abs().max().item())
assert not torch.isnan(y2).any()

# --- Test 4: ElementwiseAffine with EXTREME logs (would overflow unclamped) ---
with torch.no_grad():
    ea.logs.fill_(500.0)  # exp(500) would be inf unclamped
y3, logdet3 = ea(xx, mask, reverse=False)
x3_back = ea(y3, mask, reverse=True)
print('ElementwiseAffine forward with logs=500 (would overflow unclamped): has_nan=', torch.isnan(y3).any().item(), 'has_inf=', torch.isinf(y3).any().item())
print('ElementwiseAffine reverse with logs=500: has_nan=', torch.isnan(x3_back).any().item(), 'has_inf=', torch.isinf(x3_back).any().item())
assert not torch.isnan(y3).any() and not torch.isinf(y3).any()
assert not torch.isnan(x3_back).any() and not torch.isinf(x3_back).any()

with torch.no_grad():
    ea.logs.fill_(-500.0)  # exp(-500) underflows to 0 (safe), exp(500) in reverse would overflow
y4, _ = ea(xx, mask, reverse=False)
x4_back = ea(y4, mask, reverse=True)
print('ElementwiseAffine with logs=-500: forward has_nan=', torch.isnan(y4).any().item(), ' reverse has_nan=', torch.isnan(x4_back).any().item(), ' reverse has_inf=', torch.isinf(x4_back).any().item())
assert not torch.isnan(y4).any() and not torch.isnan(x4_back).any() and not torch.isinf(x4_back).any()

print('ALL CHECKS PASSED')
\"" 2>&1 | grep -v pkg_resources
